source.subject: fix(changelog): compare released sections at EOF

seed.description: In sectionsByTitle, the document-level normalization changed from removing one terminal newline (replace(/\r?\n$/, "")) to slice(0, -1), which always drops the last character. A changelog with no final newline loses its last character of released text, so its released sections no longer match the base and the check reports a false immutability failure. This is an off-by-one at the end of the file.

seed_verification.seeded_result: 11 pass, 1 fail: preserves non-final separators while ignoring only the document terminal newline (AssertionError at check-changelog.test.mjs:132, deepStrictEqual reports 'Released changelog sections are immutable' for a current file with no terminal newline)
